transcript: Find me a 500 piece jigsaw puzzle under twenty dollars.
why: Exercises private semantic retrieval plus numeric budget and category metadata filters without live escalation.
notes: All three expected results are 500-piece jigsaw puzzles priced at $10.99, $13.69, and $12.95 in the 2020 catalog; exclude 1,500-piece items and storage accessories even when their titles contain 500.
